after.rosterkit/contacts.py:
# owner: platform
"""Contact sheet rows for substitute teachers."""

from typing import Iterable, List

from rosterkit.models import Student

def contact_row(student: Student) -> str:
    """One aligned text row: name, section and email."""
    name, section = student.display_name, student.section
    if not student.email:
        raise ValueError(f"no email for {name}")
    return f"{name:<20} {section:<8} {student.email}"

def contact_rows(students: Iterable[Student]) -> List[str]:
    """Contact rows for all students, sorted by name."""
    roster = sorted(
        students, key=lambda item: item.display_name
    )
    if not roster:
        raise ValueError("no students given")
    return [contact_row(student) for student in roster]
